# rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation (Resource)

The `rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation` resource confirms KMS key sharing
for a manually onboarded AWS application account, after the IAM policy from
`rubrik_aws_exocompute.kms_role_policy` has been attached to the application
account's IAM role. Use `depends_on` to order confirmation after policy
attachment. RSC does not verify the attachment during confirmation.

Deleting this confirmation does not revoke KMS key sharing. The
`rubrik_aws_exocompute` resource controls the mapping and finalizes a manual
revoke on deletion. Remove the IAM policy before deleting the mapping;
RSC does not verify removal. See the
[rubrik_aws_exocompute docs](aws_exocompute.md#automated-kms-key-sharing).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rubrik = {
      source = "rubrikinc/rubrik"
    }
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
    }
  }
}

variable "application_account_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "RSC UUID of the manually onboarded application account."
}

variable "host_account_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "RSC UUID of the Exocompute host account."
}

variable "application_role_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Name of the RSC cross-account IAM role in the application AWS account."
}

resource "rubrik_aws_exocompute" "application" {
  account_id            = var.application_account_id
  host_account_id       = var.host_account_id
  automated_key_sharing = true
}

# Configure the AWS provider to manage IAM in the application account.
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "exocompute_kms" {
  name   = "rubrik-exocompute-kms-sharing"
  role   = var.application_role_name
  policy = rubrik_aws_exocompute.application.kms_role_policy

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [rubrik_aws_exocompute.application]
  }
}

resource "rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation" "application" {
  account_id = rubrik_aws_exocompute.application.account_id

  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.exocompute_kms]

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [rubrik_aws_exocompute.application]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) RSC application cloud account ID (UUID) for the manual Exocompute KMS mapping.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RSC application cloud account ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation.application
  identity = {
    id = "e912b1c8-8729-41fa-b303-ae112501c499"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) RSC application cloud account ID (UUID).

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation.application
  id = "e912b1c8-8729-41fa-b303-ae112501c499"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the RSC UUID of the application account with a confirmed manual mapping.
terraform import rubrik_aws_exocompute_kms_confirmation.application e912b1c8-8729-41fa-b303-ae112501c499
```
